## ⚡ What I Actually Do

- 🤖 **NLP & ML Tinkering** – building topic models, running sentiment pipelines, and occasionally training something that works on the first try (rare).
- 🕷️ **Automation & Scraping** – if data lives on the web, I'll find a way to pull it, clean it, and make it useful — usually with a Python script I'll refactor "later."
- 🏗️ **Full‑Stack Feature Dev** – Django on the back, JS/Flutter on the front. I enjoy both sides of the wall and regularly knock it down.
- 🔌 **IoT & Hardware Hacking** – connecting things that weren't meant to be connected and making them talk to each other anyway.
- 🐧 **Linux & DevOps** – scripting, containerising, orchestrating. My terminal is basically a second home at this point.
